## Gap register

Gaps are appended with the date they were recorded and are never edited away; closing a gap adds operations to its row.

- 2026-11-05: **Specialty breadth** — P2: no specialty operations are built; separate clinical and workflow validation per specialty.
- 2026-11-05: **International** — P2: no country packs are built; extensibility requirements only (IANA time zones, explicit currency, numbering conversion).
